package.name: adhere_monitor
package.description: Observability / offline-evaluation tools for the KAMR-MPPI ROV (CLAUDE.md Phase 5.0 Stage 5, split out of the former adhere_keyboard_input): rt_monitor_node (live CLI table of /rov/runtime_diagnostics) and benchmark_evaluator_node (trailing-window Markdown comparison of /rov/controller_state + offline-only /rov/ground_truth_odom). Zero dependency on MuJoCo/CUDA/ros2_control, so it deploys standalone on a remote Upper-Computer (GCS) laptop.
